name: Ahisamach
overview: Ahisamach is identified in Scripture as the father of Aholiab, a skilled craftsman from the tribe of Dan who was endowed with wisdom by God to carry out His commands in the construction of the Tabernacle. The passages highlight Ahisamach’s son’s giftedness not only in engraving and craftsmanship but also in teaching others, demonstrating the divine empowerment given to those who serve in holy work. Through Ahisamach’s lineage, we see God’s provision of gifted individuals equipped for specific tasks in worship and service.
